items.description: Anshul Kamboj made a significant impact in India's ODI against New Zealand, skillfully taking two wickets and aiding in restricting the opponent to a modest score of 185. His disciplined bowling, emphasised through consistent lengths and a wobble seam delivery, was crucial. With contributions from Virat Kohli and Shubman Gill, India clinched the win by achieving the revised target.

items.title: Bengaluru techie who threatened Ayushmann, Tusshar in Bishnoi gang's name arrested
items.author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
items.description: In a shocking turn of events, Mumbai Police have apprehended Vaibhav Mishra for transmitting threatening audio messages to various Bollywood stars. Posing as a member of the notorious Lawrence Bishnoi gang, he targeted high-profile celebrities, including Ayushmann Khurrana and Tusshar Kapoor. This unsettling incident followed a frightening shooting attack on Tiger Shroff, which the gang readily acknowledged, inciting widespread fear within the film industry.
